about: Meetings written to trap an AI minute-taker into inventing an owner, a date or a decision. Each trap says what a faithful minute-taker writes, and why.

meetings.title: QRIS launch sync
lines: Oke, kita mulai ya. Agenda hari ini cuma satu, launch QRIS.
Dari engineering aman. Load test kemarin lulus, 300 transaksi per detik.
Mantap. Jadi kita tetap launch tanggal 20 Oktober ya?
Dari CS, FAQ soal QRIS belum di-update sama sekali. Harus ada yang update sebelum launch.
Satu lagi, alert buat callback QRIS belum ada.
Alert itu nanti gue yang pasang ya, paling lambat Jumat.
Kalau customer minta refund untuk transaksi QRIS, prosesnya gimana? Manual?
Itu belum kebahas. Kayaknya finance yang harus jawab.
Oke, itu kita catat sebagai pertanyaan terbuka dulu.

traps.why: Everyone agreed: QRIS launches on 20 October.
Ayu says the FAQ needs updating and that 'someone' has to do it. Nobody takes it.
Tomi claims the callback alert himself.
Tomi says Friday at the latest: Friday 16 October.

meetings.title: Checkout redesign review
lines: I've updated the Figma with the new address step.
Looks good. Rina, can you start writing test cases for the address step?
Sure, I'll have them by Thursday.
One thing: the empty state for saved cards still has the old illustration.
Someone should swap that before design QA.
We could also drop the promo code field from step one. Conversion might go up.
Interesting. Let's think about it, I'm not sure legal will like hiding promo codes.
I can mock both versions if we want.
Okay. For the record, we're keeping the three-step flow, not one page.

traps.why: Laras asks Rina, and Rina accepts.
Rina says Thursday: Thursday 15 October.
Laras says 'someone should swap that'. Sekar only says 'Hmm'.
Sekar offers to mock both versions 'if we want'; the idea is then parked.
Dropping the promo code field is parked, not decided.
Agreed: the checkout keeps three steps.

meetings.title: Refund SLA weekly
lines: Minggu ini ada 47 tiket refund yang lewat SLA 3 hari.
Datanya udah gue taruh di dashboard, tapi angka buat bank transfer kayaknya belum masuk.
Bisa, nanti gue cek. Paling minggu depan ya, minggu ini lagi full.
Yang lambat itu sebenarnya di approval finance, bukan di sistem.
Kalau gitu kita perlu ngobrol sama finance soal approval otomatis buat refund di bawah 100 ribu.
Tapi keputusannya di Dewi. Kita belum bisa putuskan di sini.
Satu lagi, template email refund masih pakai bahasa yang lama, banyak yang komplain.

traps.why: Laras asks Kevin to check the bank transfer numbers; he agrees.
Kevin says 'probably next week'. No day is named.
Automatic approval is for Dewi to decide, not this meeting.
Everyone agrees the email template must change; nobody takes it.

meetings.title: Card payment retries
lines: Okay, let's talk about the card payment retries. Failures are up since Monday.
It's the 3DS timeout. The bank changed theirs to 30 seconds.
We can raise our timeout to 45 seconds. That's a one-line change.
And I'll write the incident note for Pak Hendra, by tomorrow morning.
Great. We also need to tell customer support what to say to customers.
Okay, someone brief support after this.

traps.why: The transcript does not say who Speaker 3 is. The rule: leave the label.
The transcript does not say who Speaker 2 is.
'Tomorrow morning' after a Wednesday meeting: Thursday 15 October.
'Someone brief support after this.' Nobody takes it.

meetings.title: Backend hiring debrief
lines: Andre's technical round was strong. System design was solid.
The culture interview was fine too.
So, do we make an offer?
I lean yes, but I want to see the reference check first.
I'll send HR the reference contacts today.
The second candidate is on Monday, right?

traps.why: Laras says it outright: no decision today.
Laras takes this one herself; a minute-taker that never names 'me' fails here.
'Today' is Thursday 15 October.
HR 'usually handles' the reference check. No one in the room takes it.

meetings.title: 11.11 promo planning
lines: Tahun lalu pas 11.11 traffic naik empat kali lipat. Checkout sempat lambat.
Tahun ini kita harus siap. Load test harus jalan sebelum November.
Bima nggak ada di sini, tapi tim engineering yang harus jalanin.
Banner 11.11 gue yang bikin ya, minggu depan gue kirim draft.
CS butuh skrip buat promo yang gagal dipakai. Tahun lalu banyak yang marah.
Iya, skrip itu perlu. Nanti kita lihat siapa.
Satu lagi: kita mau batasi satu voucher per user nggak?
Itu tergantung marketing. Belum bisa jawab sekarang.

traps.why: Engineering must run it, and its lead, Bima, is not in the meeting.
Sekar claims the banner.
'Minggu depan' (next week). No day is named.
'Nanti kita lihat siapa': we will see who.
The voucher limit depends on marketing.

meetings.title: Sprint retro
lines: Honestly, if I had one week with no meetings I'd rewrite the whole payment service.
Real issue: staging was reset twice this sprint and I lost my test data.
That's on me. I'll add a lock so nobody resets it without asking. Today.
The flaky checkout test. It fails one run in ten.
I looked at it last week. I think it's the clock in the test.
Okay. Last thing: we agreed to move retro to Thursdays, right?

traps.why: A joke, and Tomi says so.
Bima takes the staging lock.
'Today' is Friday 16 October.
Laras asks Tomi; he agrees.
'Next sprint'. No day is named.
Everyone agrees: retro moves to Thursdays.

meetings.title: Virtual account fee
lines: Untuk biaya admin virtual account, kita bebankan ke customer aja, 2.500 per transaksi.
Oke, kalau gitu kita bebankan ke customer.
Tapi dari riset kemarin, biaya tambahan di checkout bikin orang batal bayar.
Hmm. Ya udah, kita tanggung dulu sampai akhir tahun, nanti kita evaluasi Januari.
Oke, final: biaya admin VA kita tanggung sampai akhir tahun.
Berarti copy di checkout nggak perlu diubah ya.
Angka biayanya gue kirim ke Laras besok, buat laporan bulanan.

final: until the end of the year
traps.why: The fee was first put on the customer, then reversed: the company absorbs it until year end.
Dewi will send the fee numbers.
'Besok' after a Thursday meeting: Friday 16 October.

meetings.title: 1:1 with Pak Hendra
lines: How is the QRIS launch looking?
Good. I need a one-page summary for the board deck.
The board will ask about fraud. Do we have numbers?
Kevin has the fraud dashboard. I can ask him.
And think about whether we should hire a second PM next quarter. No need to answer now.

traps.why: Laras takes the summary herself.
'Wednesday' after a Monday meeting: Wednesday 14 October.
Laras will ask Kevin. The line names Kevin, but Laras owns it.
Pak Hendra says there is no need to answer now.

meetings.title: Checkout conversion drop
lines: Conversion checkout minggu lalu turun 3 persen.
Belum tahu. Bisa karena bug di Android, bisa karena promo selesai.
Ada bug di Android 14, tombol bayar kadang nggak muncul.
Itu udah gue fix kemarin, tinggal rilis.
Oke. Kevin, tolong pisahin datanya: Android vs iOS, dan sebelum vs sesudah promo.
Tergantung jadwal rilis mobile, biasanya Senin.

traps.why: Laras asks Kevin to split the data; he agrees.
'Kamis' after a Tuesday meeting: Thursday 15 October.
Tomi fixed the bug, but nobody says who releases it.
Releases are 'usually Monday'. No date is committed.

meetings.title: PayNusa partner call
lines: We can give you a lower MDR, 0.6 percent, if you move all card volume to PayNusa.
That's interesting, but we can't commit today. Finance needs to see it.
Understood. I'll send the proposal by email tomorrow.
On the technical side, how long is the integration?
About two weeks with our SDK.
Great. On our side, someone needs to share the proposal with finance once it arrives.

traps.why: Laras says they cannot commit today.
Mei, the partner's account manager, will send the proposal.
'Tomorrow' after a Wednesday call: Thursday 15 October.
Mei will get the sandbox keys.
Mei gives no date for the keys.
'Someone needs to share the proposal with finance.' Nobody takes it.

meetings.title: Double charges
lines: Oke, kita bahas komplain soal pembayaran ganda.
Minggu ini ada 12 kasus customer kepotong dua kali.
Itu kemungkinan dari retry di sisi kita. Log-nya gue cek hari ini.
Customer-nya perlu dikabarin, dan dananya dibalikin.
Iya, refund manual dulu. Siapa yang bisa?
Gue aja. Refund-nya gue proses besok.

traps.why: The transcript does not say who Pembicara 3 (speaker 3) is.
The transcript does not say who Pembicara 4 (speaker 4) is.
'Besok' after a Thursday meeting: Friday 16 October.

meetings.title: Checkout redesign go/no-go
lines: Go or no-go for releasing the checkout redesign on Monday.
QA is done. Two minor bugs left, both cosmetic.
Design is a go. The two bugs are fine for now.
Okay, it's a go for Monday the 19th.
I'll log the two bugs in Jira today.
I'll be on call Monday morning for the rollout.
And I'll write the release note by Sunday evening.

traps.why: A go for Monday 19 October.
Rina will log the bugs.
Tomi will be on call.
Laras will write the release note.
'Sunday evening' after a Friday meeting: Sunday 18 October.

meetings.note: A control meeting: every task has a clear owner. A minute-taker that writes 'owner unclear' everywhere fails it.

meetings.title: NPS check-in
lines: Gimana kabar semua? Sekar, liburannya kemarin seru?
Seru banget, ke Bandung doang sih.
Oke, soal NPS: September turun dikit, dari 41 ke 38.
Gue sih pengennya kita bikin dashboard NPS yang real-time, tapi itu proyek besar.
Komplain paling banyak soal refund lama, sama kode OTP yang telat masuk.
Survey-nya juga harus diterjemahin ke bahasa Inggris, buat user expat.
Oh iya, laporan NPS lengkap bulan September nanti gue kirim ke grup Senin.

traps.why: A wish ('pengennya'), put off by Laras: 'nanti-nanti aja'.
Sekar says the survey must be translated; nobody takes it.
Ayu will send the September report.
'Senin' after a Tuesday meeting: Monday 19 October.

meetings.title: Installments estimate (Laras absent)
lines: Laras minta kita siapin estimasi buat fitur cicilan.
Oke, nanti gue rangkum semuanya dan gue kirim ke Laras hari Jumat.

traps.why: Tomi claims the backend estimate.
Tomi gives no date.
Rina claims the test plan.
Rina gives no date.
Bima sends the summary to Laras. Laras is named, but she is not the owner.
'Hari Jumat' after a Wednesday meeting: Friday 16 October.

meetings.note: Laras, the owner of these minutes, was not in this meeting.

meetings.title: September settlement
lines: The bank's settlement report for September doesn't match ours. We're off by 4.2 million.
Could be the refunds that were processed twice.
Maybe. I'll reconcile it line by line, but that takes me until the end of the month.
Should we pause automatic refunds until then?
No, I don't think that's necessary.
I'll send Dewi the list of double refunds from the CS tickets, today.

traps.why: Dewi will reconcile.
Decided: automatic refunds keep running.
Ayu will send the list. The line names Dewi, but Ayu owns it.
'Today' is Thursday 15 October.

meetings.title: QRIS pilot review
lines: Pagi semua. Weekend gimana? Ada yang ke mana?
Gue ke nikahan sepupu di Bogor, macet parah.
Haha, valid. Oke kita mulai. Agenda: review pilot QRIS minggu lalu, terus persiapan launch.
Pilotnya jalan ke 5 persen user. Total 4.200 transaksi QRIS, success rate 97 persen.
Mayoritas timeout di sisi acquirer. Sisanya user batal sendiri.
Dari CS ada 31 tiket. Paling banyak soal pembayaran udah sukses tapi status di app masih pending.
Itu callback dari acquirer yang telat. Kadang baru masuk sepuluh menit kemudian.
Hmm, ntar gue cek log callback-nya deh.
Tomi bisa sekalian bikin retry buat callback yang telat kayaknya.
Hmm, itu agak gede sih kerjaannya.
Terus FAQ soal status pending perlu ditambah. Gue update hari Jumat ya.
Satu lagi. Finance minta laporan settlement QRIS harian, karena dananya masuk H+1.
Bisa, tapi bukan minggu ini. Minggu depan ya.
Soal launch tanggal 20: gimana kalau kita batasi ke 50 persen user dulu, sampai callback-nya beres?
97 persen sukses itu udah di atas target kita, 95.
Dan kalau dibatasi, kampanye marketing-nya jadi aneh.
Oke. Launch tetap untuk semua user, nggak kita batasi.
Satu lagi: kita juga harus kabarin merchant soal settlement H+1 ini.
Eh sorry, balik ke FAQ tadi. Jumat gue cuti ternyata. Senin aja ya.
Udah ya. Makasih semua, semangat minggu launch.

traps.why: 'Ntar gue cek log callback-nya deh': a light promise, but Tomi's own.
Tomi gives no date.
Bima suggests Tomi build the retry; Tomi only says it is big, and Laras puts it off.
Ayu takes the FAQ update.
Ayu first says Friday, then moves it: 'Senin aja'. After a Monday meeting: Monday 19 October.
Laras asks Kevin; he agrees.
'Minggu depan': next week, no day.
Limiting the launch to half the users was proposed and turned down.
Decided: the launch stays open to all users.
'Kita juga harus kabarin merchant': we, not a person.

meetings.title: 11.11 war room
lines: Oke, war room 11.11 pertama. Kurang dari empat minggu lagi.
Gue bawa martabak, ambil aja ya.
Oke. Pertama, voucher. Minggu lalu kita belum mutusin batasnya.
Data tahun lalu: 8 persen user pakai voucher lebih dari sekali, dan itu nyedot 30 persen budget.
Itu gede. Marketing udah setuju kalau kita batasi?
Udah, kemarin mereka bilang oke di chat.
Oke, diputuskan: satu voucher per user selama 11.11.
Kedua, banner. Sekar, versi kedua bannernya bisa?
Gue lihat dulu ya kerjaan gue minggu ini.
Terus migrasi tabel voucher. Tomi, tolong bikin script migrasinya ya.
Oh iya, data A/B test checkout kemarin gue kirim sore ini ya, ke channel squad.
Eh tunggu, script migrasi itu ternyata udah gue bikin minggu lalu. Nggak usah, Tom.
Ketiga: email ke merchant soal syarat promo.
Itu nunggu legal. Kalau legal oke, Ayu yang kirim email ke merchant.
Siap, kalau udah oke dari legal.
Btw martabaknya enak banget, beli di mana?

traps.why: Decided: one voucher per user during 11.11.
Laras asks Sekar; Sekar only says she will check her workload first.
Tomi was asked, then Bima says the script already exists: cancelled.
Kevin, between bites of martabak, will send the A/B data.
'Sore ini': this afternoon, Wednesday 14 October.
Ayu sends the email only once legal agrees.

meetings.title: SendWave vendor call
lines: Thanks for making time. How's the week going?
Busy, we're launching QRIS next week.
Congratulations! So, about OTP delivery: we can do Indonesian SMS at 210 rupiah per message.
Our current provider is around 250, but delivery is what matters. Our OTPs arrive late.
Our median delivery in Indonesia is under four seconds.
Can you also share the delivery-rate report for Indonesia, by carrier?
Let me check whether I'm allowed to share that one.
And the price, is that final?
I can revise it for your volume. I'll send the revised pricing tomorrow.
Would you sign a 12-month contract? That's where the best price is.
We'd have to discuss that with finance first.
One more thing: do you support WhatsApp OTP as a fallback?
Yes, it's in beta in Indonesia.
Okay. To be clear on our side: we won't switch providers this quarter, whatever the price. Q1 at the earliest.
Internally, someone has to compare your numbers with our current provider's.
Yeah, we'll need that before Q1.

traps.why: Raj will send revised pricing.
'Tomorrow' after a Tuesday call: Wednesday 14 October.
Raj only says he will check whether he may share the report.
Decided: no switch this quarter; Q1 at the earliest.
A 12-month contract needs finance first.
'Someone has to compare' the numbers; Bima agrees it is needed, nobody takes it.

meetings.title: Incident review: double charges
lines: Okay, um, let's start. This is the review for Wednesday's double charges.
So, uh, timeline first. At 14:02 the acquirer started timing out, and our client retried.
And the retry didn't carry an idempotency key, so the second request charged again.
Twelve tickets came in. Probably more who didn't complain.
I'll add the idempotency key check today. It's small.
Good. Then the refunds. All 37 are refunded?
The twelve with tickets, yes. The other twenty-five, not yet.
We should email the affected customers today, and refund the rest.
Uh, actually I have the full timeline open already.
Oh, then you write it, you know it better.
Fine, I'll write it. By Monday.
Thanks. Anything else? The test that should have caught this?
There's no test for retries with a timeout. Someone should add one.
Okay, um, that's it. Thanks everyone.

traps.why: The recording does not say who Speaker 3 is.
'Today' is Friday 16 October.
Speaker 4 offers, then hands it to Speaker 2, who takes it.
'By Monday' after a Friday meeting: Monday 19 October.
'We should email the affected customers': we, not a person.
'Someone should add one.' Nobody takes it.

meetings.note: A transcript with filler words and unnamed speakers, the way a recorder writes it.

meetings.title: 1:1 Laras and Bima
lines: Gimana kabar? Anak lo udah sembuh?
Udah, alhamdulillah. Kemarin sempat demam tiga hari.
Syukurlah. Oke, ada yang mau lo bahas duluan?
Iya, gue mau ambil cuti tanggal 2 sampai 6 November.
Oke, aman. Nanti gue bantu cari pengganti on-call selama lo cuti.
Thanks. Terus soal Tomi: menurut gue dia udah siap naik ke senior.
Setuju, kerjanya bagus banget di QRIS.
Rekomendasinya gue tulis minggu ini ya.
Satu lagi, soal hiring. Kita jadi buka posisi backend baru?
Udah gue omongin sama Pak Hendra. Kita nggak buka posisi baru sampai Januari, budget-nya belum ada.
Kita juga perlu ngomongin roadmap Q1, tapi nanti aja pas offsite.
Setuju. Udah capek gue hari ini, haha.

traps.why: Laras takes finding an on-call stand-in.
No date: only 'during the leave'.
Bima will write Tomi's recommendation; Tomi is named, Bima owns it.
'Minggu ini': this week, no day.
Decided: no new positions until January.
Put off to the offsite: 'nanti aja pas offsite'.
Bima's leave is news, not a task.

meetings.title: Address form design critique
lines: So this is the new address form. The big change is the map picker at the top.
I like it. Let's go with the map picker.
Wait, one thing. On older Android phones the map SDK crashed in my tests last month.
Mostly 2 GB RAM devices. That's a lot of our users outside Java.
Hmm. Then let's not decide on the map picker today.
Sekar, can you test it on a low-end device first?
Sure, I'll do it by Thursday.
If this ships late I'll personally hand-deliver every package, haha.
Haha, I'll hold you to that.
Also, the error states have no copy yet. Someone should write it.
The fallback without the map is the old form, right?

traps.why: First 'let's go with the map picker', then 'let's not decide on the map picker today'.
Laras asks Sekar; she agrees.
'By Thursday' after a Tuesday meeting: Thursday 15 October.
'Someone should write it.' Nobody takes it.
A joke, with laughter.
